name: collapsible-section-card
title: Collapsible Section Card
description: A surface card featuring a top disclosure header with an animated chevron toggle to collapse body contents.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Minimal
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Medium
Shape: Rounded
Motion: Mechanical
Typography: Grotesk
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Card Chevron Disclosure: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
